equity.name: China Vanke Co., Ltd.
equity.summary: China Vanke Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of properties in the Mainland China, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company operates through Property Development and Property Management segments. It develops residential buildings, commercial offices, and other ancillary facilities. The company also provides property management and related services to purchasers and tenants of its own developed residential properties, shopping arcades, and office buildings, as well as to properties developed by external property developers; and undertakes construction contracts. In addition, it is involved in logistics and warehousing, hotel and resort, education, and housing rental businesses. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.

equity.name: Shenzhen Fountain Corporation
equity.summary: Shenzhen Fountain Corporation engages in real estate development, clean energy, transportation, and waste management activities in China. The company operates various fleets of electric vehicles (EVs) at residential and tourism developments under the HANSOME EValet brand, as well as light truck EVs for intra city logistics; and provides power-charging infrastructure at various transportation hubs and residential communities. It also develops low carbon neighborhood; and operates city chilling stations to provide cooling services to the communities, and infrastructure for cold chain food and beverage storage and logistics, as well as cold chain retail spaces and EV cold chain distributors. Shenzhen Fountain Corporation was founded in 1990 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

equity.name: Shenzhen Zhenye (Group) Co.,Ltd.
equity.summary: Shenzhen Zhenye (Group) Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, management, and rental of real estate properties in China. The company provides residence, commercial properties, villas, etc. It is also involved in the shantytowns transformation and distinctive town construction activities. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

equity.name: Shenzhen Quanxinhao Co., Ltd.
equity.summary: Shenzhen Quanxinhao Co., Ltd. owns and operates hotels in China. The company operates the Grand hotel located in Shenzhen and the Asia Gulf hotel located in Xiamen. It also provides property management, financial information consulting, venture capital, financial investment, equity investment, and investment management services. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

equity.name: China Baoan Group Co., Ltd.
equity.summary: China Baoan Group Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of cathode and anode materials for lithium battery manufacturers worldwide. It also researches on drive systems for new energy vehicles sand automotive assembly plants; manufactures and sells precision metal parts that are used in hard disk drives, hydraulic equipment, and auto parts, as well as parts for other purposes; researches and develops new graphite materials; and develops and manufactures military drilling simulators. In addition, the company offers power-charging connectors for new-energy vehicles; AC/DC power charging connector products for electric vehicles; and ear-nose-throat and respiratory system products. Further, it plants lian tree; researches and development, manufactures, and sells neem products; develops and manages real estate projects; and invests in venture capital, financial, and industrial investment projects. Additionally, the company engages in the wholesale and retail of pharmaceutical products; operation of a chain of hospitals; and provision of hemorrhoid products. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

equity.name: Shenzhen Ecobeauty Co., Ltd.
equity.summary: Shenzhen Ecobeauty Co., Ltd. distributes natural gas machines and natural gas in China. It is involved in the storage, transportation and distribution, sale, maintenance, and management of natural gas and liquefied gas; and the manufacture and installation of machines, equipment, and related components. The company was formerly known as Beijing Shenhuaxin Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Ecobeauty Co., Ltd. in May 2016. Shenzhen Ecobeauty Co., Ltd. is based in Shenzhen, China.

equity.name: Shahe Industrial Co., Ltd
equity.summary: Shahe Industrial Co., Ltd. develops, operates, and manages real estate properties in China. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

equity.name: Konka Group Co., Ltd.
equity.summary: Konka Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, produces, and sells electronic products in China and internationally. It offers televisions, refrigerators, washing machines, personal electronic appliances, and kitchen and bathroom appliances; and home AV, IPTV set-top boxes, OTT terminals, digital TV receivers, digital products, wearable and health products, electric products and switch plugs, power banks, mobile communication equipment and terminal products, daily-use and automotive electronic products, satellite navigation and transportation systems, fire-fighting and security systems, office equipment, computers, displays, and large screen display systems. The company also provides LED back light, illumination, and light-emitting devices; packaging products; Touch TV AIO wireless broadcasting television transiting equipment; and emergency broadcast system equipment, electronic parts and components, molds, plastic and rubber products, packing materials, security and monitoring products, wireless and cable digital television systems and system integration services, and technical consultancy and after-sale paid services. In addition, it engages in the provision of wholesale, retail, import and export, and relevant support services of the aforesaid products; maintenance and technical consultant services for electronic products; ordinary cargo transportation, domestic and international freight forwarding, and warehousing services; management of supply chain; consultancy on enterprise management; self-owned property leasing and management services; and outsourcing services of information technology and business procedures, as well as recovers waste electrical appliances and electronic products. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Konka Electronic Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Konka Group Co., Ltd. in August 1995. Konka Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

equity.name: Shenzhen China Bicycle Company (Holdings) Limited
equity.summary: Shenzhen China Bicycle Company (Holdings) Limited engages in the production, assembly, purchase, and sale of bicycles and electric bicycles. It offers bicycles under the EMMELLE brand. The company also engages in the lithium battery material, and jewelry and gold businesses. It offers its products through various e-commerce platforms. Shenzhen China Bicycle Company (Holdings) Limited is based in Shenzhen, China.

index.name: SSE Conglomerates Index
index.summary: The SSE Conglomerates Index aims to reflect the overall performance of companies listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) that operate across multiple industries or sectors. It provides investors with a benchmark for evaluating the performance of diversified businesses in the Chinese market. The index includes companies with significant operations in various sectors, offering a broad representation of the conglomerates landscape.

index.name: SSE Corporate Governance Index
index.summary: The SSE Corporate Governance Index evaluates and measures the corporate governance practices of listed companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE). It is designed to provide investors with a tool to assess the quality of corporate governance among Chinese companies. The index helps promote sound corporate governance principles and practices within the Chinese equity market.

index.name: SSE 180 Corporate Governance In
index.summary: The SSE 180 Corporate Governance Index is designed to measure the performance of 180 Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) listed companies that demonstrate strong corporate governance practices. It aims to provide investors with a benchmark for companies adhering to high standards of governance. The index seeks to promote better corporate governance among listed companies in China.

index.name: SSE Social Responsibility Index
index.summary: The SSE Social Responsibility Index measures the performance of Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) listed companies that demonstrate strong social responsibility practices. It aims to provide a benchmark for investors interested in socially responsible investments within the Chinese market. The index considers various environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors in its selection criteria.

index.name: SSE50 Fundamental Weighted Inde
index.summary: The SSE50 Fundamental Weighted Index is designed to measure the performance of the 50 largest and most liquid stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), weighted by fundamental factors. These fundamental factors include metrics like book value, cash flow, sales, and dividends. This weighting scheme aims to provide an alternative to market capitalization weighting, potentially capturing value opportunities.

index.name: SSE180 Fundamental Weighted  In
index.summary: The SSE180 Fundamental Weighted Index measures the performance of 180 stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), weighted by fundamental factors instead of market capitalization. The weighting uses fundamental factors such as book value, cash flow, sales, and dividends. It provides a different perspective compared to market-cap weighted indices.

index.name: SSE Downstream Industry Index I
index.summary: The SSE Downstream Industry Index I is designed to track the performance of companies listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) that are involved in downstream industries. This includes sectors like manufacturing, processing, and distribution. It provides a benchmark for investors interested in tracking the performance of downstream sectors within the Chinese economy.

index.name: SSEF 200 Index
index.summary: The SSEF 200 Index represents the largest 200 stocks traded on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, aiming to reflect the overall performance of the large-cap segment of the Chinese stock market. The index is weighted by free-float market capitalization. It is a benchmark for investors seeking exposure to the performance of major Chinese companies.

index.name: SSEF 300 Index
index.summary: The SSEF 300 Index is designed to reflect the performance of 300 stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE). It represents a broad range of companies and sectors within the Chinese market. The index serves as a benchmark for investors interested in tracking the overall performance of the Shanghai stock market.

index.name: SSEF 500 Index
index.summary: The SSEF 500 Index tracks the performance of 500 stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE). It aims to provide a comprehensive representation of the overall Chinese stock market. The index serves as a benchmark for investors looking to track the broader market performance of Chinese equities.

index.name: SSE Health Care theme Index Ind
index.summary: The SSE Health Care theme Index Ind aims to reflect the performance of companies listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) that are related to the healthcare industry. This includes pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and healthcare service providers. The index provides a benchmark for investors interested in the Chinese healthcare sector.

index.name: SSE 180 Stability Index
index.summary: The SSE 180 Stability Index measures the performance of 180 companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) that exhibit relatively stable performance characteristics. It uses metrics like volatility and financial stability in its stock selection. The index serves as a benchmark for investors seeking exposure to lower-volatility stocks in the Chinese market.

index.name: SSE380 Fundamental Weighted Ind
index.summary: The SSE380 Fundamental Weighted Index is designed to measure the performance of 380 stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), weighted by fundamental factors. These fundamental factors include metrics like book value, cash flow, sales, and dividends. This weighting scheme provides an alternative to market capitalization weighting, potentially capturing value opportunities.

index.name: SSE180 Volatility Weighted Inde
index.summary: The SSE180 Volatility Weighted Index measures the performance of 180 stocks on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), weighted based on their historical volatility. Stocks with lower volatility receive a higher weighting in the index. The index aims to provide a benchmark for investors seeking exposure to lower-volatility stocks in the Chinese market.

index.name: SSE380 Volatility Weighted Inde
index.summary: The SSE380 Volatility Weighted Index measures the performance of 380 stocks on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), weighted based on their historical volatility. Stocks with lower volatility are assigned a higher weighting in the index. It aims to provide a benchmark for investors seeking exposure to lower-volatility stocks in the Chinese market.

index.name: SSE 380 Stability Index
index.summary: The SSE 380 Stability Index measures the performance of 380 companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) that exhibit relatively stable performance characteristics. It uses metrics like volatility and financial stability in its stock selection. The index serves as a benchmark for investors seeking exposure to lower-volatility stocks in the Chinese market.

index.name: SSE Select Consumption Industri
index.summary: The SSE Select Consumption Industri aims to reflect the performance of companies listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) that are related to the consumption industry. This includes companies involved in the production and sale of consumer goods and services. The index provides a benchmark for investors interested in the Chinese consumption sector.

index.name: CSI CN Mainland New Energy Inde
index.summary: The CSI CN Mainland New Energy Index is designed to track the performance of companies listed on mainland Chinese stock exchanges that are involved in the new energy sector. This includes companies related to renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and electric vehicles. The index provides a benchmark for investors interested in the new energy industry in China.

index.name: CSI China Mainland Consumer Ind
index.summary: The CSI China Mainland Consumer Ind is designed to track the performance of companies listed on mainland Chinese stock exchanges that are involved in the consumer sector. It offers a benchmark for measuring the performance of Chinese consumer-related businesses. The index offers exposure to companies that provide goods and services to consumers in mainland China.

index.name: CSI China Mainland Natural Reso
index.summary: The CSI China Mainland Natural Reso is designed to track the performance of companies listed on mainland Chinese stock exchanges that are involved in the natural resources sector. It provides a benchmark for investors interested in tracking the performance of companies engaged in the extraction, production, and processing of natural resources in China. The index includes companies in sectors like mining, oil and gas, and forestry.
